headline: Canada Imposes Tariffs on Canned Vegetable Imports Above Quota
summary: Ottawa will introduce tariffs on canned vegetable imports exceeding a set quota from trading partners including the U.S. and Europe starting December 1 to protect domestic industry.
why: Import tariffs alter agricultural supply chains and trade dynamics between Canada and major international partners.

impacts.name: Canada
impacts.why: Quotas and tariffs protect domestic food producers from foreign import competition.
